in_marathi.name: Yogita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yogita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yogita is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Yog’, meaning ‘to join’ or ‘to unite’. It is often associated with the idea of joining the divine and the human within oneself, and is therefore a name of great spiritual significance. In Hindu mythology, Yogita is often considered a manifestation of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
